Power Lessons From China

AJ Cortese

Gavekal Technologies: New Energy | 26 Oct 2026

The US data center boom is facing a power crunch. So far, delays and cancellations due to electricity shortages have been sporadic. By some point in 2028, they could become systemic, and might force a significant slowdown in data center construction. The main response by hyperscalers has been to build their own captive power plants. But this is an expensive stopgap that will be slowed by shortages of turbines and transformers. Building more on-grid power capacity will inevitably take time, so it will be important for the US to figure out how to better use batteries and distributed renewables generation to make power demand and supply more flexible.
